title: Quantum Resource Estimation for Minimising Energy Grid Losses
summary: Distribution network reconfiguration (DNR) can minimise power losses by identifying the optimal topology of the electricity grid. Determining the minimum loss configuration is NP-hard, and classical optimisation methods struggle to scale to real-world distribution grids. This paper explores the use of gate-based quantum computing to solve DNR for power loss reduction. We formulate DNR as a higher-order unconstrained binary optimisation (HUBO) problem, avoiding the need for auxiliary variables, thereby reducing the required number of qubits.
